    ENDPOINT["S3 gateway endpoint"]
  end
  S3[("S3 blob bucket")]
  SHARED["ECR images,<br/>Secrets Manager,<br/>CloudWatch logs"]
  OUT(["GitHub, model APIs,<br/>Temporal"])
  WORKER --> DB
  API --> DB
  PRIVATE --> ENDPOINT --> S3
  PRIVATE --> NAT -->|internet gateway| OUT
